_meta: Biome variants derived from visual image analysis of all BiomeSketch tile/prop assets. Each variant defines a distinct sub-environment within its parent biome — used for worldgen sub-zone selection, BiomeSketch preview, and future mob spawner integration.

meadow.name: Sunlit Meadow
meadow.desc: Open pastoral grassland, full sun. Flower patches are the biome signature — sparse trees, clear traversal lanes.

mob.name: Fernwhisk Hare
mob.desc: A fast skittish rabbit with oversized ears and a flower-spotted coat. Bolts at the first sign of movement.

meadow.name: Overgrown Glade
meadow.desc: Darker, more verdant meadow near the forest edge. Willows and rock outcrops dominate. Heavier grass textures.

mob.name: Thornback Stag
mob.desc: A large deer with thorn-wrapped antlers. Peaceful grazer that turns aggressive when cornered.

meadow.name: Dry Grassland
meadow.desc: Pale, wind-dried grass near the desert or badlands transition. Cracked earth shows through thinning turf.

mob.name: Dusttail Lizard
mob.desc: A golden-scaled lizard that basks on sun-warmed rocks. Deceptively fast when threatened.

forest.name: Oak Canopy
forest.desc: Dense oak groves on a lush plains2 floor. Heavy canopy walls, clearings cut between grove clusters. Gary's floor-rethink in action.

mob.name: Ironbark Boar
mob.desc: A heavy boar with bark-like hide plates that absorb blows. Charges hard when disturbed from its rooting.

forest.name: Mushroom Dell
forest.desc: Dark, mossy hollow where canopy light barely reaches. Toadstools cluster around ancient stumps. The air smells of damp earth.

mob.name: Sporecap Lurker
mob.desc: A camouflaged creature shaped like a large toadstool cap. Perfectly still until a player steps within range.

forest.name: Ancient Pines
forest.desc: Tall snow-dusted conifers with sparse undergrowth between them. Quieter and colder than the oak groves. Dead trees mark old lightning strikes.

mob.name: Ashwing Owl
mob.desc: A large spectral owl that glides without a sound. Only appears at dusk. Its gaze inflicts a brief Blind status.

forest.name: Deadfall Clearing
forest.desc: A clearing inside deep forest where old trees have collapsed. Stumps, logs, and bare earth mark where a grove once stood.

mob.name: Greyback Wolf
mob.desc: A pack hunter that ambushes from the treeline bordering clearings. Rarely alone — always check the shadows.

mountain.name: Grassy Foothills
mountain.desc: Lower slopes where grass still grows between stone outcrops. Copper veins run through the surface rock. Pines mark the treeline.

mob.name: Ridgeback Ram
mob.desc: A mountain goat with stone-plated brow horns. Nimble on any slope. Charges repeatedly if you stay above it.

mountain.name: Alpine Meadow
mountain.desc: Gary's h2 band — a high-altitude meadow where plains2 tiles mix with weathered stone. Cold wind, short grass, long views.

mob.name: Stonetalon Eagle
mob.desc: A large eagle with stone-grey feathers. Dives from altitude with enough force to stagger the player.

mountain.name: Craggy Summit
mountain.desc: Wind-scoured rock and windswept new-variant tiles. Stone breaks through the thinning grass. Silver ore begins to surface.

mob.name: Frostclimber Troll
mob.desc: A pale grey troll that hunches motionless against rock faces. Slow — but each hit staggers. Regenerates if left alone.

mountain.name: Snowcap Peak
mountain.desc: The highest reachable point. Crisp blue-grey stone under thin snow crust. Starmetal ore surfaces rarely. Wisps drift here at night.

mob.name: Voidstone Elemental
mob.desc: A floating mass of cracked rock infused with starmetal energy. Rare and extremely dangerous. Emits a gravity-pull aura.

snow.name: Frost Plains
snow.desc: Open flat snowfield. The clean white canvas. Lone pines break the horizon. Rolling terrain hides wolves between crests.

mob.name: Frostback Wolf
mob.desc: White-furred pack hunters. Faster and hardier than forest wolves. Coordinate their attacks — one distracts, others flank.

snow.name: Frozen Deadwood
snow.desc: Gary's desolate intent — open snow littered with the corpses of trees. Stumps half-buried. Dead branches reach from under the drift.

mob.name: Hollowbone Wraith
mob.desc: A spirit that inhabits the hollow cores of dead trees. Emerges as a wisp that circles its host tree before attacking.

snow.name: Ice Field
snow.desc: Frozen ground where ice patches dominate. Slippery terrain. Silver ore breaks through frozen rock. Wisps are drawn to the cold light.

mob.name: Glacial Shard Crab
mob.desc: A large crustacean with an ice-crystal shell that deflects blows. Emerges from frozen lake margins. Slow but armoured.

beach.name: Sandy Shore
beach.desc: The classic beach — clean sand at h1, deep water visible at h0. Minimal props. Safe arrival zone.

mob.name: Sandscuttler Crab
mob.desc: A small fast crab that zips along the waterline. Harmless alone, swarms in groups of 4-6. Pinches for modest damage.

beach.name: Rocky Tidepool
beach.desc: More exposed stone, darker wet sand, dense shore rocks. Boulders jut from the shallows. High tide line visible.

mob.name: Brineback Turtle
mob.desc: A sea turtle that hauls onto rocks to rest. Slow on land but its shell deflects most attacks. Passive unless cornered.

beach.name: Driftwood Shore
beach.desc: Higher shore, dry sand, old waterlogged logs and stumps washed up. Seagulls nest in the debris.

mob.name: Razorwing Gull
mob.desc: An aggressive seagull with blade-edged wings. Dive-bombs anything near its driftwood nest. Fast, low HP, highly annoying.

dungeon.name: Stone Vault
dungeon.desc: Standard dungeon — grey cut-stone floors, brazier light, wooden chests. The entry tier every dungeon run starts with.

mob.name: Crypt Shambler
mob.desc: A slow undead guard in corroded stone armour. Patrols predictable routes. Telegraphs attacks clearly — punishing to first-timers.

dungeon.name: Lava Vein Depths
dungeon.desc: Lower dungeon where the floor glows with orange ore-cracks. Heat shimmer. Braziers everywhere — not for light, for warmth against the cold stone.

mob.name: Emberskin Crawler
mob.desc: A four-legged lizard with molten patches on its hide. Leaves scorched footprints. Explodes on death dealing fire splash.

dungeon.name: Corrupted Halls
dungeon.desc: Mossy, fungal-overtaken stone. Walls weep with green ooze. Mushroom clusters grow from cracks. The corruption spreads here.

mob.name: Veinmold Lurker
mob.desc: A fungal-corrupted humanoid with mold-plate armour. Releases a spore cloud on death that inflicts Poison. Can infect corpses.

dungeon.name: Crystal Sanctum
dungeon.desc: The deepest tier — walls veined with mana crystals. Geometric floor patterns. Tightly guarded by magical constructs.

mob.name: Prismatic Sentinel
mob.desc: A golem built from mana crystals. Immune to magic damage. Shatters on death releasing homing crystal shards.
